title: AccountPositionMark
description: account.position_mark r1: one market mark of one held contract of one account capture; append only, a correction is a row with a higher attempt.

capture_id.description: Identifier of the capture the mark belongs to, as in account.position.

alias.description: Alias of the gateway entry, never the account id.

marked_at.description: Instant the mark was taken, UTC.

con_id.description: Broker contract id of the position marked.

attempt.description: Attempt number from 1; a retry writes a row with the next number.

price.description: Mark as decimal text; empty when basis is none.

bid.description: Bid as decimal text; empty when absent.

ask.description: Ask as decimal text; empty when absent.

last.description: Last trade as decimal text; empty when absent.

close.description: Previous close as decimal text; empty when absent.

market_data_type.description: Market data type the gateway answered with; 0 when unknown.
